title: Billing Guidance for Storage Rental Fees, Promotional Credit, Prepay Discount and Reversals
content:
Storage Rental fees for access cards and keys, and credits for the first-month promotion, prepayment and reversals, follow the rules below. Each percentage, month count and fee is the one the rented product carries.

## Fees

- A lost or additional storage access card is billed at the product's access card fee.
- A replacement key is billed at the product's key replacement fee.

## Credits

A credit reduces one storage charge on the Storage Rental. The credits on a Storage Rental are the reservation credit, the promotional credit, the prepay discount and the charge reversal.

**First-month promotion.** The promotion credits the product's first-month promotion percentage of the first full month's rent when the resident commits to the product's minimum number of rental months for the promotion. The promotional credit is that percentage multiplied by the monthly rent, rounded to the cent.

**Prepay discount.** The prepay discount credits the product's prepay discount percentage of each prepaid month when the product's required number of months is paid together in advance. The credit for each prepaid month is that percentage multiplied by the monthly rent, rounded to the cent. A product whose required number of prepaid months is 0 has no prepay discount.

**No stacking in one month.** The promotion and the prepay discount never apply to the same month: a prepaid month that received the promotion earns no prepay discount.

**Recapture.** A promotion is recaptured as an early termination fee only through the Storage Rental early termination terms, never as a separate charge.

**Charge reversal.** A charge reversal credits a charge posted on the Storage Rental, once per charge.

## Which credit applies to a month (hypothetical month on a product that has both offers)

| Commitment to the promotion's minimum months | Month is the first full month | Month is one of a block of the required number of months prepaid together | Credits on that month |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Promotional credit only |
| Yes | Yes | No | Promotional credit |
| Yes | No | Yes | Prepay discount |
| No | Yes | Yes | Prepay discount |
| No | No | No | Neither |

## Worked figures (hypothetical rentals at the product's standard monthly rent)

**Standard Storage Unit (5x5), $55.00 a month; promotion 50% with a 3-month commitment; prepay discount 5% when 6 months are paid together.** The resident commits to 3 months and pays 6 months together in advance, the first full month among them.

- Promotional credit on the first full month: 50% of $55.00 is **$27.50**.
- Prepay discount: 5% of $55.00 is $2.75 per month, on the 5 prepaid months that did not receive the promotion: **$13.75** in total.

**Oversized Storage Suite (10x10), $165.00 a month; promotion 100% with a 6-month commitment; prepay discount 8% when 12 months are paid together.** The resident commits to 6 months and pays 12 months together in advance, the first full month among them.

- Promotional credit on the first full month: 100% of $165.00 is **$165.00**.
- Prepay discount: 8% of $165.00 is $13.20 per month, on 11 months: **$145.20** in total.

**Standard Storage Unit (5x5) with 5 months paid together.** Fewer than the 6 months required are paid together, so no prepay discount is credited.

## Basis questions

**Is the promotion applied to the prorated first month?** No. It is a share of the first full month's rent.

**Can a reversed charge be reversed twice?** No. A charge reversal credits a charge once.
